personality_one_liner: A crisp, tactile, and frictionless financial tool that feels native to the OS, emphasizing clarity, typography, and purposeful whitespace over heavy decoration.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards and sections are separated by large margins (xl/2xl) to create distinct visual chunks. Touch targets are strictly >=44pt.

do's: Use expo-blur with a tinted translucent base for the bottom tab bar.
Apply to sticky headers that overlay scrolling transaction lists.
Use a frosted glass effect on the floating action button (FAB) for adding expenses.
Apply to the hero balance card when overlaying the abstract sage green texture.
dont's: Do not use blur on standard list items or small dense data rows.
Do not use blur on form inputs.
Do not skip the underlying tint - glass must be readable regardless of the scrolling content underneath.

screens.name: Dashboard
screens.purpose: A high-level view of financial health prioritizing net balance, recent activity, and one-touch expense logging.

states.loading: Skeleton UI for the hero card and top 3 transaction rows.
states.empty: Illustration of a pristine wallet with a 'Log your first expense' CTA.
states.error: Readable error message stating 'Unable to load transactions' with a 'Retry' button.

screens.layout: Hero balance card at the top (using the abstract sage texture background, gradient scrim, and overlaid text). Below the card, a segmented control or filter chips (All, Split, Personal). Then, a grouped transaction list (by Date). A sticky Floating Action Button (FAB) anchored at the bottom right or center, above the tab bar, for quick 'Add Expense'.

screens.name: Add Expense (Modal)
screens.purpose: A frictionless, progressive-disclosure flow to log an expense or scan a receipt.

states.loading: N/A for entry, but button shows loading spinner during submit.
states.error: Inline validation for missing amount or category.

screens.layout: Full-sheet modal. Top section features a massive numeric input for the Amount (using tabular numbers). Below, a horizontal scrolling list of friends/groups to split with. Followed by Category selection (tinted icon chips) and an optional Notes field. A prominent 'Scan Invoice' button sits near the top to bypass manual entry. Fixed 'Save' CTA at the bottom inside a KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Scan Invoice
screens.purpose: AI-powered camera interface to auto-extract expense details from receipts.

states.loading: Scanning animation (laser line moving up and down the captured image) with 'Extracting details...'.
states.error: Error toast 'Could not read receipt' with a retake button.

screens.layout: Full-screen camera view. Translucent overlay with a clear cutout rectangle for the receipt. Large capture button at the bottom. Once captured, a bottom sheet slides up showing the AI-extracted fields (Amount, Date, Merchant) for user confirmation before redirecting to the Add Expense modal.

screens.name: Split Bills
screens.purpose: A clear, trust-centric view of who owes whom, reducing social friction through net balance simplification.

states.empty: Illustration of a handshake with 'No active splits. Invite a friend.' CTA.

screens.layout: Top section shows a simplified 'Net Balance' (e.g., 'You are owed $50 in total'). Below is a list of active groups and friends, displaying real avatar photos (tier 1 imagery) and their specific balance (green if they owe you, grey if settled). Tapping a friend opens a detailed transaction history with a 'Settle Up' button.

screens.name: Profile & Settings
screens.purpose: Manage identity, authentication, and core app preferences like currency.

states.empty: Logged out state showing a 'Sign in with Google' button prominently.

screens.layout: Header with user's Google avatar and name. A card-based settings list below. Key rows: 'Currency Toggle (USD/INR)', 'Linked Accounts', and 'Sign Out'. Use tinted icon containers (brandTertiary bg) for the leading icons on each setting row.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the '1 iOS-Native Clean' personality. Do not introduce any blue, indigo, or purple hues - the app relies entirely on a crisp monochrome base with Sage/Moss Green accents.

For the hero balance card on the Dashboard, overlay the 'hero_card_bg' image, apply a mandatory top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at 70%+ opacity), and render text using onSurfaceInverse to guarantee readability.
Implement the Add Expense flow as a bottom sheet modal or full-screen flow with a massive, tabular-aligned numeric input field at the top.
For the Split Bills section, implement Net Balance Simplification: show a consolidated 'who owes whom' total rather than just a raw ledger. Use the provided friend_avatar images for participants.
When integrating Google Auth or displaying the Google logo, utilize the provided 'google_logo' image asset, falling back to a vector icon only if strictly necessary due to background clipping.
Adhere strictly to the haptics mapping. Bind 'selection' haptics to currency toggling and participant selection, and 'success' to expense logging.
